name: Recipe Tracker
description: This module helps you track when which recipe was applied since the module was installed.
project_description:
Recipe Tracker logs every time a recipe is applied to a site. The log identifies which version of the recipe was applied by whom at what time. This is useful for tracking the order of recipe applications when working on complex recipes and site templates. It also provides useful context when evaluating an existing site, as you can more quickly understand how a site arrived at its current configuration.

 This module is a dependency of Commerce Recipe: Core . We encourage all Drupal Commerce recipes to use this core recipe to create a uniform experience for merchants evaluating and building on the platform via recipes. Including Recipe Tracker by default will help us diagnose issues in Commerce support channels.
